info.title: Skill Eval Platform API
info.description: Backend service for scene-scoped evaluation question management.

BadCaseIn.title: BadCaseIn
BadCaseIn.description: A rejected real result with the teacher feedback bound to it.

BootstrapResponse.title: BootstrapResponse
BootstrapResponse.description: Anonymous first-run probe; reveals only whether registration is open.

CaseIn.title: CaseIn
CaseIn.description: One evaluation question payload inside a batch upload command.

CriterionIn.title: CriterionIn
CriterionIn.description: Administrator-supplied criterion; identical shape to the AI output contract.

MemoryMaterialIn.title: MemoryMaterialIn
MemoryMaterialIn.description: Raw memory fragment the local Agent loaded this round and deemed relevant.

QuestionDeleteRequest.title: QuestionDeleteRequest
QuestionDeleteRequest.description:
Protected hard-delete contract.

``confirmation_title`` is only required for questions that were ever
published; it must match the current title exactly (after Unicode NFC
normalization and trimming) or the delete is rejected.

ReferenceExampleIn.title: ReferenceExampleIn
ReferenceExampleIn.description: Teacher-provided content the local Agent actually read, then distilled.

SceneConnectionStatusView.title: SceneConnectionStatusView
SceneConnectionStatusView.description:
What a scene credential holder may learn about its own connection.

Never includes the token, token hash, or any other scene's data.

SceneCredentialIssuedView.title: SceneCredentialIssuedView
SceneCredentialIssuedView.description:
Returned once at create/replace time for the handoff convenience.

Unlike the old model, the plaintext is also persisted so the administrator
can reveal it later from the scene page.

SceneCredentialPlaintextView.title: SceneCredentialPlaintextView
SceneCredentialPlaintextView.description:
Administrator-only reveal of the scene's current credential.

Served with ``Cache-Control: no-store``; never part of a listing or status
response.

SceneUpdateRequest.title: SceneUpdateRequest
SceneUpdateRequest.description:
Full desired metadata state; the same validation rules as creation.

The web client always submits both fields together, so ``description=null``
unambiguously clears the description.
